story.fullStory:
Bobbie Gentry's "Niki Hoeky" — original release 1967. "Mississippi Delta" is a song written and recorded by American singer-songwriter Bobbie Gentry.

The song was produced by Kelly Gordon and Bobby Parris.

It was originally released as the B-side of Gentry's debut single "Ode to Billie Joe" on July 10, 1967.

Niki Hoeky was released in 1967.
